mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is a sizzling eighty-six degrees at Verona Community Park, but it feels like a sticky ninety-two, so expect to melt if you step outside. In city news, local students in grades K through twelve have until July twenty-second to submit designs for the official I Voted sticker contest. Meanwhile, in police news, an officer tried to stop a motorcycle with no license plate, but the rider fled at high speed, blowing through red lights. Stay cool out there, and grab today's sweet flavor of the day at Culver's, Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Have a great day!
